translation.portfolioAppDesc: Portfolio App is a modern professional portfolio platform designed to showcase your projects and skills. Built with React, it allows users to manage and showcase their work in an intuitive, adaptable, and multilingual interface. With support for light and dark modes, dynamic translations, and a responsive structure, Portfolio App ensures a fluid user experience on any device. Ideal for developers, designers, and professionals who want to highlight their digital skills.
translation.crudAppDesc: This project is a full-stack web application that allows managing available employees using CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete). The architecture is based on Spring Boot for the backend, React.js for the frontend, and a MySQL relational database for data storage.
